lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: solving right triangles for sides and angles
lessonRef.title: Discussion or problem seminar: solving right triangles for sides and angles

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One approach is shown. There is at least one other that works.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: For each, name a second method before you solve it.

items.prompt: From a point 24 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 10 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 5 and 12 and hypotenuse 13. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 5. Find tan θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has hypotenuse 205 and one leg 45. Find the other leg.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Express sin 18° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 72°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 108°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 18°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 162°, because the angles are supplementary

items.prompt: From a point 36 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 15 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 21 and 72 and hypotenuse 75. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 21. Find tan θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Argue for one method over another. Say what makes it better, not just that it is.

items.prompt: A right triangle has hypotenuse 82 and one leg 18. Find the other leg.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
